units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 6:1">Esth. R. to III, 9</cite> <he>עמד שטן וה׳ עליהם וכ׳</he> Satan arose and denounced them (the Israelites) before the Lord.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 3">Ex. R. s. 3</cite> <he>מה הנחש כשה׳ וכ׳</he> as well as I smote the serpent when he spoke evil (of the Lord).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 3:13">Ib.</cite> <he>לקח את שלו על שה׳</he> was punished because he had spoken lightly (of the Israelites, <cite ref="Exodus 4:1">Ex. IV, 1</cite>); a. fr.
